 2027 NFL Draft order, team needs: Full first-round picks for all 32 teams
 See where every team picks in the first round and which positions each franchise could target in the 2027 NFL Draft
 By
 Josh Edwards 
 Nov 9, 2026
 at
 12:03 am ET 
 •
 5 min read
 Getty Images 
 Only Monday Night Football between the Bills and Vikings remains in Week 9 of the NFL regular season. There is clear separation between the teams contending for a Super Bowl and those more focused on the 2027 NFL Draft . 
 Where is each team picking in the first round? And which positions might they address? Those answers and more can be found below.  
 As a reminder, four teams -- Green Bay, Indianapolis, Chicago and the Los Angeles Rams -- do not own a first-round pick in 2027 due to trades, including the Micah Parsons , Sauce Gardner , Jeffery Simmons and Myles Garrett deals.
 Here is the 2027 NFL Draft order:   
 Here is the current 2027 NFL Draft order
 1. Los Angeles Chargers (0-8)
 Team needs : WR, EDGE, DL, CB, IOL
 Potential free agents : LB Daiyan Henley , EDGE Tuli Tuipulotu , CB Donte Jackson , EDGE Khalil Mack , TE David Njoku 
 2. Tennessee Titans (1-7)
 Team needs : EDGE, CB, OT, RB, WR, DL
 Potential free agents : RB Tony Pollard , EDGE Jermaine Johnson, RB Tyjae Spears , DL Solomon Thomas 
 3. Miami Dolphins (1-7)
 Team needs : QB, EDGE, WR, OT, CB
 Potential free agents : OT Austin Jackson , TE Greg Dulcich , CB Julius Brents , EDGE Josh Uche , CB Darrell Baker Jr .
 4. New York Jets via Indianapolis Colts (2-7)
 Team needs : QB, DL, CB, LB, WR
 Potential free agents : DL David Onyemata , QB Geno Smith , EDGE Kingsley Enagbare , DL Harrison Phillips 
 5. Philadelphia Eagles (2-7)
 Team needs : IOL, OT, CB, TE, DL
 Potential free agents : CB Riq Woolen, TE Dallas Goedert , DL Moro Ojomo , OG Tyler Steen , EDGE A.J. Epenesa 
 6. New York Jets (2-7)
 Team needs : QB, DL, CB, LB, WR
 Potential free agents : DL David Onyemata, QB Geno Smith, EDGE Kingsley Enagbare, DL Harrison Phillips
 7. Washington Commanders (2-5-1)
 Team needs : CB, EDGE, DL, WR, IOL
 Potential free agents : DL Daron Payne , EDGE Durance Armstrong, EDGE K'Lavon Chaisson , LB Frankie Luvu , WR Stefon Diggs 
 8. Tampa Bay Buccaneers (3-6)
 Team needs : DL, EDGE, IOL, CB, WR, TE
 Potential free agents : OG Cody Mauch , EDGE Yaya Diaby , EDGE A'Shawn Robinson , TE Payne Durham 
 9. Arizona Cardinals (3-6)
 Team needs : QB, WR, EDGE, OT, CB
 Potential free agents : EDGE Baron Browning , LB Mack Wilson , EDGE Zaven Collins , DL Dante Stills , RB Bam Knight
 10. Atlanta Falcons (3-6)
 Team needs : OT, CB, EDGE, IOL, TE
 Potential free agents : S Jessie Bates III , OT Jawaan Taylor , C Ryan Neuzil , QB Tua Tagovailoa , EDGE Samson Ebukam 
 11. Houston Texans (3-5)
 Team needs : OT, IOL, DL, RB, LB
 Potential free agents : EDGE Jadeveon Clowney , OT Trent Brown , WR Tank Dell , WR Kayshon Boutte , QB Davis Mills 
 12. New Orleans Saints (3-5)
 Team needs : EDGE, DL, RB, CB, S

 Team needs : IOL, TE, CB, EDGE, WR
 Potential free agents : OT Ikem Ekwonu , OT Rasheed Walker , C Luke Fortner , TE Tommy Tremble , S Nick Scott 
 14. New York Jets via Dallas Cowboys (4-5)
 Team needs : QB, DL, CB, LB, WR
 Potential free agents : DL David Onyemata, QB Geno Smith, EDGE Kingsley Enagbare, DL Harrison Phillips
 15. Las Vegas Raiders (4-5)
 Team needs : WR, CB, DL, IOL, EDGE
 Potential free agents : QB Kirk Cousins , WR Tre Tucker , OG Spencer Burford , S Isaiah Pola-Mao , S Jeremy Chinn 
 16. Baltimore Ravens (4-5)
 Team needs : CB, DL, RB, OT, EDGE
 Potential free agents : CB Marlon Humphrey , DL Calais Campbell , C Ethan Pocic , LB Trenton Simpson , RB Justice Hill 
 17. Cleveland Browns (5-4)
 Team needs : CB, IOL, EDGE, QB, RB, DL, TE
 Potential free agents : QB Deshaun Watson , S Ronnie Hickman , EDGE Isaiah McGuire , EDGE Sam Williams, EDGE Derek Barnett 
 18. Seattle Seahawks (5-4)

 Potential free agents : OG Quenton Nelson , RB Zach Charbonnet , C Olu Oluwatimi, QB Drew Lock , EDGE Uchenna Nwosu 
 19. Cleveland Browns via Los Angeles Rams (5-4)
 Team needs : CB, IOL, EDGE, QB, RB, DL, TE

 20. New England Patriots (5-4)
 Team needs : S, IOL, LB, DL, WR

 21. Dallas Cowboys via Green Bay Packers (6-3)

 29. Denver Broncos (7-2)
 Team needs : TE, S, CB, OT, LB
 Potential free agents : TE Evan Engram , CB Riley Moss , WR Marvin Mims , OG Ben Powers , CB Ja'Quan McMillian

 Team needs : IOL, QB, S, TE, RB, EDGE

 Team needs : EDGE, IOL, OT, WR, DL
